notes.title: Kingdoms Of Marazia: 8/10/18 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Fixed character creation bug not fully loading the character creation menu.

Another major pathfinding revision, improves attacking and moving in groups.

"Pathfinding preview" removed.

Improvements to UI, new chatbox and resources panel.

Ability to see list of online players

Rankings List is live, improvements will come in the future

notes.title: Kingdoms Of Marazia: 8/8/18 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Added feedback upon entering the world, will give information about why it didn't work.

Rewrote pathfinding (moving calculations from the client to the server) allowing much smarter pathfinding.

Fixing bug causing buildings to sometimes become movable.

Fixed castles being unable to be attacked by warriors and archers at certain times.
